nodes.label: Checkpoint and Rollback on Failure
nodes.rationale: Never resume from an unverified midpoint; prevents contextual debt compounding.

nodes.label: Internal Event Bus
nodes.rationale: Consumers subscribe to events rather than hardcoded service-to-service calls.

nodes.label: Four-Layer Architecture (control, execution, intelligence, data/memory)
nodes.rationale: Separates deciding (Cockpit+Hermes) from heavy execution so no compute lives in the control plane.

nodes.label: Hermes Controller
nodes.rationale: Hermes decides, routes, schedules, escalates but never executes code, edits files, calls production APIs or holds money/launch approval; agents act, Hermes decides.

nodes.label: Independent Evaluator (different model/vendor)
nodes.rationale: Mitigates correlated failure when the builder grades its own work.

nodes.label: AI Model Routing Table
nodes.rationale: No single best model; route per task type per 2026 benchmarks, evaluator from a different vendor.

nodes.label: Schema-Validated Tool Wrapper with Allowlist
nodes.rationale: Direct fix for the 2026 Gemini CLI supply-chain attack class: file content is data, never instructions.

nodes.label: Memory and Second Brain
nodes.rationale: An agent without memory re-derives the business each task and repeats mistakes.

nodes.label: Template-First Doctrine
nodes.rationale: Only proven path to a full rebuild; lifted only after N consecutive from-scratch builds pass at the same defect rate.

nodes.label: Three Approval Tiers (auto-pass, notify-and-wait, hard-gate)
nodes.rationale: Carried over from 2.0 Autonomy Switchboard; money, launch and external sends always hard-gated.

nodes.label: Audit: WFACT 2.0 to 3.0 (KEEP/REPLACE classification)
